gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic is modern and clean, with a welcoming gap in its c. Azonix hits harder above it, a wide display face with no thick-thin swing, so the two split the work.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans: Flat-ruled, wide-mouthed lettering that looks cut from a single bar. Noto Sans is the relief, with lowercase filling most of the letter height while Azonix keeps every bar uniform.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unj: Stencil-flat and stern, Azonix stands wide and refuses to soften. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined takes over for reading, its curves leaving generous gaps by the stems so text feels easygoing.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-anatolian: Azonix draws without any heavy-to-light shift, every stroke wide and wire-straight. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs lifts its x-height near cap height with outward-pointing tips, giving a looser, friendlier feel beside it.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Reading here feels clean, with generously opened small letters and a pronounced x-height. Noto Sans Arabic would carry paragraphs smoothly, with Azonix up top drawing diagonals that match its horizontals.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Azonix looks bent from a single wire, wide and commanding. Noto Sans Bengali sits beside it with distinctly open letter mouths and barely taller capitals, a softer voice for the text.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Azonix keeps a monoweight stroke throughout, with wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk. And Noto Sans Bhaiksuki follows with tightly coiled, rope-like lowercase and open apertures that read easily.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: On every curve, Noto Sans Brahmi reads open-ended, with a high mean line. Azonix is made for commanding display lines, whereas the body font's open-ended curves are made for quiet, continuous text.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Tubular, wire-bent and stern: that is Azonix at a glance. Noto Sans Buhid, with generous gaps where curves meet stems and a high-set x-height, takes the quieter job of carrying the text.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-carian: Crisp and scissor-open, Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals well apart. Azonix supplies the single-weight authority up top while the body font quietly handles the sentences below.
